import zlib, struct

def chunk(type, data):
    length = len(data)
    return struct.pack(">I", length) + type.encode() + data + struct.pack(">I", zlib.crc32(type.encode() + data) & 0xffffffff)

# RGBA 48x16, 8-bit
ihdr = struct.pack(">IIBBBBB", 48, 16, 8, 6, 0, 0, 0)
data = chunk("IHDR", ihdr)

# raw pixels: width*4*height + filter byte per row
rowdata = b""
for y in range(16):
    rowdata += b"\x00"  # filter byte 0 (none)
    for x in range(16):
        rowdata += b"\x80\x80\x80\xff"  # floor - light gray
    for x in range(16):
        rowdata += b"\x30\x30\x30\xff"  # wall - black
    for x in range(16):
        rowdata += b"\xc8\xc8\xc8\xff"  # door - white

idat = chunk("IDAT", zlib.compress(rowdata))
iedt = chunk("IEND", b"")

png = b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n" + data + idat + iedt
with open("assets/tiles.png", "wb") as f:
    f.write(png)
print("wrote PNG, size", len(png))
EOF
